pages.name: Old Benoni: 2.d5 e6 3.c4
pages.notes: Plan 3 blunted a g7-bishop that is not there; plan 4 pressed a d4-pawn that does not exist. Rewrote plans 1-4 (a rejected reason for e4-e5 fixed and re-reviewed); British spelling.

pages.name: Old Benoni: 2.d5 Nf6 3.Nf3 g6 4.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed Be2 with the e-pawn on e2, pushed f4 through the f3-knight and wrote castling as 0-0; plan 2 named ...e5 as the break (it is ...e6). Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Benoni: Schmidt, 3.e4 g6
pages.notes: Plan 3 wrote the knight route as a6-c7 and said a d7-knight supports ...e6. Rewrote plan 3 (reviewer rejection fixed and re-reviewed); British spelling.

pages.name: Old Benoni: Schmidt, 3.Nc3 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed Be2 and castled with the e-pawn on e2; plan 4 told White, the side with more space, to trade pieces. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Benoni: Schmidt, 3.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Re8 before castling; plan 1 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Benoni: Schmidt, 6.Bb5+
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...b7-b5 onto White's bishop; plan 1 aimed to stop an ...e5 break that is not Black's plan here. Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: Old Benoni: Schmidt, 6.h3
pages.notes: Plan 3 wrote the knight route from a6 before the knight gets there. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni Defense: Old Benoni
pages.notes: Plan 1 attacked a d5-e4 duo before e4 is played; plan 2 met ...f5 with f4; plan 4 promised a kingside attack. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Benoni: Czech, 3.c4 d6
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed a knight ...Nf6-e8-g7 onto the g7-pawn; plan 4 aimed to control White's own c4-square. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Benoni: Czech, 3.c4 d6 4.e4
pages.notes: Plan 2 routed a knight ...Nf6-e8-g7 onto the g7-pawn; plan 1 described only an f4 attack. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling.
